summary: Retest of the new acceptance matrix (quick-link own-card highlight, hero fills first screen with 80px/80px gap symmetry, Tag One coming-soon pill parity + contrast, rings-outside/disclaimer alignment, footer legal note full width, how-it-works left/right balance, design kit download) plus full prior regression. 4 backend pytest cases pass (3 signups + 1 new design-kit zip download). 6 brand-new browser checks + 18 re-run regression checks (incl. a freshly regenerated Clerk ticket for auth-entry-signed-in) all pass -- 24/24 checks green, 0 bugs found.

Verified again at 390px for the puppy-one link (hash #puppy-one, highlighted=true).
